en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall monument with a statue of Dante standing on top of a multi-tiered pedestal surrounded by sculptural reliefs. The monument is set in a park with benches, trees, and mountains visible in the background. An ornate streetlamp stands to the right. The caption at the bottom reads in Italian: "TRENTO - Monumento a Dante".
